deployed_by: railway up from the independently verified signed source
deviation_reason: the promoter preflight requires a successful rollback anchor in provider history; dispatcher history held one CRASHED and four FAILED deployments and no SUCCESS deployment, so no anchor was available.

root_cause_of_prior_crash.symptom: dispatcher process exited with an unhandled 'error' event from a pg pool
root_cause_of_prior_crash.cause: no 'error' listener was attached to the pg pools, so an idle-client error was thrown as an uncaught exception
root_cause_of_prior_crash.fix: one shared guardPoolErrors(pool) applied at both pool factories; the guard logs the error class only

caveats: Because this deployment bypassed the promoter, its source binding is the verified signed source rather than a promoter-issued provider receipt.
No rollback anchor exists for this service; recovery would require a fresh railway up from a verified source.
The dispatcher's runtime behavior was observed through its own startup and stability logs, not through a production job run.
